text:
In 2024 the Valley's sugar mill, the last in Texas, shut down after 50 years, citing heat and a shortage of irrigation water. Hundreds were laid off. And many Valley towns get their water through the same irrigation canals that serve the fields.

Watch the full breakdown on YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=auormf6yM2Q

Sources: KSAT; Texas Workforce Commission; KRGV. Narration is AI-generated. Not financial advice.
